messages:
Harper: Heads-up: we're prepping an embargoed announcement for the new EU region + latency benchmarks. Target lift Fri 07:00 UTC. Draft release and assets at https://go.redwood/eu-launch-draft
Diego: Copy. I'll queue embargo emails at 06:15 UTC and a follow-up for APAC at 06:40 UTC. Press list: The Register EU, Sifted, TechCrunch EU, Bloomberg.
Laila: I'll own live-monitoring and reporter calls. Who's the on-the-record engineer? @Diego or @Harper?
Diego: Happy to be on-the-record for infra details. Harper will do product-level quotes.
press-bot: Scheduled: embargo_email_sender will fire at 06:15 UTC (in ~55m).
Legal: Quick flag: do not use absolute phrasing around latency; change any "lowest latency" claims to "lower median latency in EU region tests." Also remove raw partner datasets from press kit.
Harper: Noted. Updating CEO quote and partner mention. Will replace any absolute claims.
Design: Final hero exported (EU map + chart). Need confirmation on alt text: "Median latency benchmarks, EU region".
Design: alt text set. Social crops uploaded as eu_hero_square.png and eu_banner.png.
SalesOps: Please add a short customer-facing blurb for AEs in the internal kit; they'll want a one-liner and an FAQ.
Harper: Good call. Sales blurb added to the internal folder.
Diego: CDN purge scheduled at T+00:02 post-publish. Ops increased burst capacity for 07:00-09:00 UTC window.
Laila: I'll prepare two FAQ bullets on measurement methodology and regional availability. Also arranging two on-the-record engineers: Omar (runtime) and Lina (infra) available 06:45-08:30 UTC.
Harper: Manual publish snippet in case automation fails:
```
# emergency publish
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/publish -H "Authorization: Bearer $PUBLISH_TOKEN" -d '{"slug":"eu-region-launch-2026"}'
```
Diego: Embargo email will include TL;DR, embargo time, embargoed link, CEO quote, and contact info for Laila for on-the-record.
press-bot: Reminder queued: embargo_email_sender will fire at 06:15 UTC.
Legal: Wording approved at 05:10 UTC for the updated quote and partner line.
SalesOps: AE blurb approved. I'll push to #sales now.
Harper: Action items recap: Diego - press emails, Laila - monitoring & Qs, Design - final assets, Legal - wording cleared, SalesOps - AE kit. React with :thumbsup: when done.
Diego: :thumbsup:
Laila: :thumbsup:
Design: :thumbsup:
Legal: :thumbsup:
SalesOps: :thumbsup:
Harper: Thanks team. Final dry run at 06:55 UTC in this thread. If anything blocks, escalate to #release-control and ping me directly.
